source_evidence: some invest in all of the securities included in a market index, while others invest in only a sample of the securities included in a market index.
answer: Index funds can track an index in two broad ways. With full replication, a fund invests in all the securities included in the index. With sampling, it invests in only some of them. Sampling can make the fund’s performance less likely to match the index exactly, so the fund may have tracking error.
